identity.title: Lock unknown producer event preservation through production path

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Prove source-private/unknown events from real canonical producer packages survive audit, import, storage and rebuild as traceable evidence without being treated as clean governance facts or forcing source-specific semantics.
human_pressure.why_now: 8064 already showed many producer-private events. Preserving them losslessly is required for framework neutrality and future auditability.
do_not_misread: Unknown event type is not invalid evidence by default.
Preservation does not mean projecting producer-private semantics into core governance.
red_lines: No new event-type mapping without production evidence.

machine_core.goal: Lock lossless preservation and non-projection semantics for unknown producer events across the canonical pipeline.
red_lines: Do not canonicalize private payloads into invented governance facts.
Do not turn warnings into failures merely because event type is unknown.
invariants: Unknown events retain event_id, event_type, timestamp, payload and scope_ref where supplied.
Known governance result remains based only on recognized evidence.
Unknown private events remain inspectable after storage/rebuild.

producer.artifact: production-derived EverRun fixture plus existing second-producer private event

observable_effect.assertion: Unknown producer events are preserved and traceable without becoming invented governance semantics.

proofs.assertion: Tests cover at least two distinct producer identities and full suite passes.

failure_semantics: Dropped unknown evidence is a provenance regression.
Unknown-to-clean projection is a governance regression.

steps.title: Identify real unknown events
details: Use unknown/private events already present in accepted fixtures from EverRun and the second producer.

steps.title: Assert preservation
details: Verify source fields survive canonical storage and remain retrievable.

steps.title: Assert non-invention
details: Verify private events alone do not synthesize authority/approval/budget/scope/validation facts.

acceptance: Unknown events survive with traceable identity and payload.

must_check: At least two producer identities are exercised.
Unknown event payload/identity preservation is explicit.
reject_if: Unknown events are dropped to reduce warnings.
Producer-private events are mapped into core semantics without evidence.
